Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 6, Verse 2

“Know that what they call renunciation is yoga, Pandava. For no one becomes a yogin without having renounced self-will.”

The two words Arjuna keeps opposing are declared identical. And the thing to be renounced is named precisely: sankalpa, the wilful intention that plans outcomes in advance.
